parts.name: work slots
parts.what: one request in flight: its work item, the engine's answer to it, and a free-list entry

parts.name: deferred dispatches
parts.what: a slot waiting to retry a dispatch a full component queue refused

parts.name: lane state
parts.what: one account's ordering: the seq it has issued, its continuity check and its quarantine flag

parts.name: open batch effects
parts.what: a judged effect in the batch being filled, waiting for consensus to be asked

parts.name: batches awaiting consensus
parts.what: a proposal handed to consensus and not answered, apart from the slot list it will answer

parts.name: spare batch buffers
parts.what: one effect of recycled batch room and the slot id beside it, so proposing allocates nothing

parts.name: ack backlog
parts.what: an answer a client has not collected, held until it does or intake pauses

parts.name: queued pending writes
parts.what: a committed decision the pending engine has not taken yet

parts.name: account records
parts.what: one account's four durable columns and the id kept beside them

parts.name: account index
parts.what: an account id against its dense handle, resolved once at intake so no later stage re-hashes

parts.name: idem keys
parts.what: a transaction id already seen, so a retry is answered rather than applied twice

parts.name: pending index
parts.what: where one hold is: a fingerprint, an ambiguity bit and a record address. Never what it is

parts.name: pending budget groups
parts.what: a live budget group's member count and remainder -- the one place those two are kept

parts.name: pending overlay
parts.what: what the sequencer has decided about a hold and not handed over yet, plus its pins

parts.name: pending writeback buffer
parts.what: a block of records not written yet: how far a restart replays, so it is the recovery bound

parts.name: pending resident blocks
parts.what: a written block kept in memory so a resolution need not read a device: the latency bound

parts.name: pending stored blocks
parts.what: a block in the segment files -- memory today, and the disk figure once the store is a directory

parts.name: volume read cache
parts.what: a block kept from a read the volume already answered, so a re-read costs no device

parts.name: volume write lane
parts.what: a block the write thread holds while its pwrite is outstanding

parts.name: volume read pool
parts.what: a block one read thread reads into, so a pread allocates nothing

parts.name: pending record
parts.what: one hold inside a block: its key, both accounts, its amounts, its ledger and its budget group

parts.name: kept log
parts.what: a committed effect the log still holds, because no snapshot has let it be truncated

parts.name: proposals in flight
parts.what: one proposal outstanding, apart from the effects it carries
